public static class Solution
{
    public static bool IsBalanced(string s)
    {
        var stack = new Stack<char>();
        foreach (char c in s)
        {
            if (c == '(' || c == '[' || c == '{')
            {
                stack.Push(c);
            }
            else if (c == ')' || c == ']' || c == '}')
            {
                if (stack.Count == 0) return false;
                char top = stack.Pop();
                if ((c == ')' && top != '(') || (c == ']' && top != '[') || (c == '}' && top != '{'))
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return stack.Count == 0;
    }
}

public static class Solution
{
    public static string ToRoman(int n)
    {
        var romanNumerals = new List<(int value, string symbol)>
        {
            (1000, "M"), (900, "CM"), (500, "D"), (400, "CD"),
            (100, "C"), (90, "XC"), (50, "L"), (40, "XL"),
            (10, "X"), (9, "IX"), (5, "V"), (4, "IV"), (1, "I")
        };

        var result = new StringBuilder();

        foreach (var (value, symbol) in romanNumerals)
        {
            while (n >= value)
            {
                result.Append(symbol);
                n -= value;
            }
        }

        return result.ToString();
    }
}

public static class Solution
{
    public static int[][] MergeIntervals(int[][] intervals)
    {
        if (intervals == null || intervals.Length == 0)
            return new int[][] { };

        Array.Sort(intervals, (a, b) => a[0].CompareTo(b[0]));

        var result = new List<int[]>();
        int[] current = intervals[0];

        for (int i = 1; i < intervals.Length; i++)
        {
            if (intervals[i][0] <= current[1])
            {
                current[1] = Math.Max(current[1], intervals[i][1]);
            }
            else
            {
                result.Add(current);
                current = intervals[i];
            }
        }

        result.Add(current);
        return result.ToArray();
    }
}

public static class Solution
{
    public static string[] TopWords(string text, int k)
    {
        var wordCounts = new Dictionary<string, int>();
        var words = text.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t', '\n', '\r', ',', '.', '!', '?', ':', ';', '-', '_', '/', '\\', '[', ']', '{', '}' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);

        foreach (var word in words)
        {
            var lowerWord = word.ToLower();
            if (wordCounts.ContainsKey(lowerWord))
            {
                wordCounts[lowerWord]++;
            }
            else
            {
                wordCounts[lowerWord] = 1;
            }
        }

        var sortedWords = wordCounts
            .OrderByDescending(w => w.Value)
            .ThenBy(w => w.Key)
            .Select(w => w.Key)
            .ToArray();

        return sortedWords.Take(k).ToArray();
    }
}

public static class Solution
{
    public static int ParseDuration(string s)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(s))
            return -1;

        int totalSeconds = 0;
        int hourCount = 0, minuteCount = 0, secondCount = 0;
        bool hasHour = false, hasMinute = false, hasSecond = false;

        for (int i = 0; i < s.Length; i++)
        {
            if (i + 1 < s.Length && s[i + 1] == 'h')
            {
                if (hasHour)
                    return -1;
                hourCount = int.Parse(s.Substring(0, i));
                hasHour = true;
                i++;
            }
            else if (i + 1 < s.Length && s[i + 1] == 'm')
            {
                if (hasMinute)
                    return -1;
                minuteCount = int.Parse(s.Substring(0, i));
                hasMinute = true;
                i++;
            }
            else if (i + 1 < s.Length && s[i + 1] == 's')
            {
                if (hasSecond)
                    return -1;
                secondCount = int.Parse(s.Substring(0, i));
                hasSecond = true;
                i++;
            }
            else
                return -1;
        }

        if (!hasHour && !hasMinute && !hasSecond)
            return -1;

        totalSeconds = hourCount * 3600 + minuteCount * 60 + secondCount;

        return totalSeconds;
    }
}

public class Solution
{
    public static int[] SpiralOrder(int[,] matrix)
    {
        int rows = matrix.Rank == 1 ? matrix.GetLength(0) : matrix.GetLength(0);
        int cols = matrix.Rank == 1 ? matrix.GetLength(1) : matrix.GetLength(1);
        int[] result = new int[rows * cols];
        int index = 0;

        int top = 0, bottom = rows - 1, left = 0, right = cols - 1;

        while (index < rows * cols)
        {
            // Move from left to right
            for (int i = left; i <= right && index < rows * cols; i++)
            {
                result[index++] = matrix[top, i];
            }
            top++;

            // Move from top to bottom
            for (int i = top; i <= bottom && index < rows * cols; i++)
            {
                result[index++] = matrix[i, right];
            }
            right--;

            // Move from right to left
            for (int i = right; i >= left && index < rows * cols; i--)
            {
                result[index++] = matrix[bottom, i];
            }
            bottom--;

            // Move from bottom to top
            for (int i = bottom; i >= top && index < rows * cols; i--)
            {
                result[index++] = matrix[i, left];
            }
            left++;
        }

        return result;
    }
}

    public static long EvalRpn(string expression)
    {
        var tokens = expression.Split(' ');
        var stack = new System.Collections.Generic.Stack<long>();

        foreach (var token in tokens)
        {
            if (long.TryParse(token, out long value))
            {
                stack.Push(value);
            }
            else
            {
                var b = stack.Pop();
                var a = stack.Pop();
                switch (token)
                {
                    case "+":
                        stack.Push(a + b);
                        break;
                    case "-":
                        stack.Push(a - b);
                        break;
                    case "*":
                        stack.Push(a * b);
                        break;
                    case "/":
                        stack.Push(a / b);
                        break;
                }
            }
        }

        return stack.Pop();
    }
}

public static class Solution
{
    public static int Distance(string a, string b)
    {
        int n = a.Length;
        int m = b.Length;
        int[,] dp = new int[n + 1, m + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++)
        {
            dp[i, 0] = i;
        }

        for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++)
        {
            dp[0, j] = j;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++)
            {
                if (a[i - 1] == b[j - 1])
                {
                    dp[i, j] = dp[i - 1, j - 1];
                }
                else
                {
                    dp[i, j] = 1 + Math.Min(Math.Min(dp[i - 1, j], dp[i, j - 1]), dp[i - 1, j - 1]);
                }
            }
        }

        return dp[n, m];
    }
}

        }

        return 0;

public static class Solution

    public static long Evaluate(string expression)
    {
        var tokens = expression.Split(new[] { ' ', '\t', '\n', '\r' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        var stack = new Stack<long>();
        var operators = new Stack<char>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < tokens.Length; i++)
        {
            if (tokens[i] == "(")
            {
                operators.Push('(');
            }
            else if (tokens[i] == ")")
            {
                while (operators.Peek() != '(')
                {
                    var op = operators.Pop();
                    var right = stack.Pop();
                    var left = stack.Pop();
                    if (op == '+')
                        stack.Push(left + right);
                    else if (op == '-')
                        stack.Push(left - right);
                    else if (op == '*')
                        stack.Push(left * right);
                    else if (op == '/')
                        stack.Push(left / right);
                }
                operators.Pop(); // Remove '('
            }
            else if (char.IsDigit(tokens[i][0]))
            {
                long num = 0;
                while (i < tokens.Length && char.IsDigit(tokens[i][0]))
                {
                    num = num * 10 + (tokens[i][0] - '0');
                    i++;
                }
                i--;
                stack.Push(num);
            }
            else if (tokens[i] == "-" && i + 1 < tokens.Length && char.IsDigit(tokens[i + 1][0]))
            {
                // Unary minus
                stack.Push(-stack.Pop());
            }
            else
            {
                operators.Push(tokens[i][0]);
            }
        }
        
        while (operators.Count > 0)
        {
            var op = operators.Pop();
            var right = stack.Pop();
            var left = stack.Pop();
            if (op == '+')
                stack.Push(left + right);
            else if (op == '-')
                stack.Push(left - right);
            else if (op == '*')
                stack.Push(left * right);
            else if (op == '/')
                stack.Push(left / right);
        }
        
        return stack.Pop();
    }
}

### Step 1: Count numbers divisible by 3
The numbers divisible by 3 from 1 to 1000 are:
$$
\left\lfloor \frac{1000}{3} \right\rfloor = 333
$$

### Step 2: Count numbers divisible by 5
The numbers divisible by 5 from 1 to 1000 are:
$$
\left\lfloor \frac{1000}{5} \right\rfloor = 200
$$

### Step 3: Count numbers divisible by both 3 and 5 (i.e., by 15)
The numbers divisible by 15 from 1 to 1000 are:
$$

$$

$$

$$

$$
